task_instance: Produce a full Arch Linux triage document (per the skill's required Output Format: Summary, Triage Steps, Remediation Commands, Validation, Rollback/Cleanup) for a concrete, representative problem: after `pacman -Syu` bumped the kernel and the nvidia driver together, the system boots to a black screen with an nvidia/DRM module load failure, while a fallback kernel entry is still available in GRUB.
evidence: This is a text-generation/consulting skill: its deliverable is a written diagnostic document (with copy-paste-ready pacman/systemctl/journalctl commands) for a described problem, not live execution against a real Arch system. Verified environment first: `cat /etc/os-release` shows Ubuntu 24.04 (not Arch), and `which pacman` found nothing, so no real pacman/nvidia system exists here or could be installed (no network/apt allowed) -- but the skill's actual job (author the triage plan) does not require running pacman itself, only producing correct, well-formed guidance. Wrote /tmp/.../triage_report.md containing all 5 required sections (checked with `grep -E '^## '`: Inputs, Summary, Triage Steps, Remediation Commands, Validation, Rollback/Cleanup) covering: reading /var/log/pacman.log, comparing `uname -r` vs installed nvidia/linux packages, `pacman -Qk/-Qkk` integrity checks, `journalctl -k -b -1` and `journalctl -b -1 -u display-manager.service` log inspection, `mkinitcpio -P` initramfs rebuild, `pacman -S --needed linux-headers nvidia-dkms nvidia-utils` remediation, `dkms autoinstall`, `grub-mkconfig` bootloader update, validation via `modinfo nvidia | grep vermagic`, `modprobe`/`lsmod`, `nvidia-smi`, `systemctl --failed`, and a rollback/cleanup section covering `pacman -U` downgrade from local cache, `IgnorePkg` pinning, orphan removal (`pacman -Qdtq` / `pacman -Rns`), and `paccache -rk2`. Extracted all 3 bash code blocks with a python3/regex script into all_commands.sh and syntax-checked them with `bash -n all_commands.sh` -> SYNTAX_OK, confirming the deliverable's commands are well-formed shell. Files produced: triage_report.md (the deliverable), all_commands.sh (verification artifact).
